plugins.name: cloudflare
plugins.description: Skills for the Cloudflare developer platform: Workers, Durable Objects, Agents SDK, Wrangler and cf CLI, Turnstile, sandboxing, web performance, plus the Cloudflare MCP server. Trimmed from cloudflare/skills (Apache-2.0) to install within platform limits.

plugins.name: thaifi-wallet
plugins.description: Non-custodial ThaiFi wallet for AI agents: pair an on-chain access key, check balances and spending limits, top up via PromptPay, transfer, pay x402/MPP services, and issue TIP-20 / ERC-1155 tokens with the thaifi CLI.
